name: Twilight Zone 2
source:
Youko, the protagonist's girlfriend, has disappeared. In order to find her he must venture into the dreaded mansion inhabited by sex-hungry women.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc88/twilight-zone-ii-nagisa-no-yakata]mobygames[/url]]
translation:
主角的女友洋子失踪了。为了找到她，他必须闯入一座住着饥渴难耐女人的可怕宅邸。

[来源：[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc88/twilight-zone-ii-nagisa-no-yakata]Moby Games[/url]]
